unit.target: Cargo stable cargo vendor implementation at rust-lang/cargo commit 7941be6fb416b4cd9666aef7b858dfea25587a8c
unit.action: Inspected only the official Cargo vendor implementation needed to determine whether .cargo-checksum.json files enumerate copied package files and whether stale files in an existing vendor directory are removed.
unit.result: For package destinations that Cargo actually repopulates, cargo vendor first removes the destination directory, then copies or unpacks the selected files, records a checksum for every copied/included path in file_cksums, and writes that map as the files member of .cargo-checksum.json. Default vendoring also tracks pre-existing non-dot top-level vendor entries and removes entries not matched by the current resolved package set. However, a version-suffixed registry package with an already-existing .cargo-checksum.json takes an early continue path: Cargo does not remove or recopy that package directory and does not recompute its checksum map. Therefore checksum-map completeness is supported for the files produced by a fresh repopulation, but stale extra internal files are not proven to be cleaned in the registry reuse fast path. --no-delete additionally preserves unmatched top-level vendor entries; dot-prefixed top-level entries are not placed in the deletion set.
